heading: Membership
lead: Except as provided in this chapter, the rights, privileges, and designation of classes of members are as provided in the bylaws. The membership of the corporation consists of—

tree.text: nine individuals designated by the President; and
representatives of the civilian organizations listed in section 220102(4) of this title, and of the public at large, as provided in the bylaws.
